title: cydonia vulgaris pyriformis
intro: Cydonia vulgaris pyriformis, commonly known as quince, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the mountainous regions of the Northern Hemisphere. The health benefits of quince include its use in treating digestive issues, such as constipation and diarrhea, as well as its potential to lower cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of quince include its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against infections and cell damage. Quince contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
